$comment: Stopwords for the no-spanish-leakage ESLint rule. See ADR-014 + PRY-019. Match is case-insensitive with word boundaries (\b) and the regex `u` flag for accented chars (función, decisión). Add new stopwords here when a future PRY surfaces a pattern not yet covered. Order is alphabetical for human review. Multi-word phrases (eg. 'una vez') match only with the exact whitespace as written here — the hyphen variant 'una-vez' would not match this entry; if such a variant ever surfaces, add it as a separate stopword.
